permitDetails.description: Permit-level metadata extracted exactly from the document. Do not infer or normalize beyond date formatting.

permitNumber.description: Primary permit/registration identifier exactly as written, without its label. If multiple identifiers exist, select the primary one and note others in extractionNotes.

permitIssuanceDate.description: Date the permit was issued in YYYY-MM-DD format if unambiguous; otherwise null.

permitExpirationDate.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format if explicitly stated; otherwise null.

facilityName.description: Facility name exactly as written in the permit. Do not normalize.

facilityAddress.description: Full facility address verbatim, including county and ZIP when present.

facilityCounty.description: County name verbatim, whether shown separately or within the address.

stateFacilityID.description: State facility identifier verbatim; distinct from equipmentFacilityID. Labels vary ('Facility ID No.', 'Registration No.', 'Source ID', etc.). Return value without label; null if absent.

initialConstructionCommencedNotification.description: True if permit requires notification of construction commencement date. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

constructionCommencedNotificationWindowD.description: Number of days within which construction commencement must be reported (e.g., 30). Leave null if not specified.

initialStartupNotificationRequired.description: True if permit requires notification of initial startup date. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

startupNotificationWindowDays.description: Number of days within which startup must be reported (e.g., 15). Leave null if not specified.

permitCopyOnsiteRequired.description: True if permit requires keeping a copy onsite. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

rightOfEntryClause.description: Right-of-entry language enabling inspection, noting timing (e.g., 'whenever the facility is in operation'). Null if absent.

extractionNotes.description: Use only for multiple permit identifiers, ambiguous facility name/address, or ambiguous date format; otherwise null.

generatorSets.description: Array of generator set objects. Do not merge generator sets even if they share make/model. List in order they appear in the document.

items.description: One entry per generator unit or group as listed in the permit (e.g., EG01, EG04-EG05, 1510-4).

referenceNumber.description: Unit or group identifier verbatim as used in the permit (e.g., 'EG01', 'EG04-EG05'). Copy with spacing. Do not merge references.

numGenerators.description: Count of physical generators in this reference. 1 for single units. For grouped references, use the stated count only (e.g., 'six generators' → 6); null if ambiguous or unstated. Do not infer from reference numbers.

includedInPermitProject.description: True if 'new'/'included in this permit action'; false if 'existing'/'previously permitted'; null if not mentioned.

originalPermitDate.description: Original permit or construction commencement date in YYYY-MM-DD. Partial dates: first day of month/year (e.g., 'September 2007' → '2007-09-01'). Null if absent.

equipmentFacilityID.description: Equipment facility identifier verbatim; distinct from referenceNumber. Null if absent.

make.description: Manufacturer name verbatim (e.g., 'Cummins', 'Caterpillar'). First named if multiple options. Null if absent.

model.description: Model designation verbatim. First named if multiple options. Null if absent.

ratedCapacityKW.description: Rated output in kW as a number. Convert MW to kW (×1000). For ranges, use stated nominal/typical or smallest. No HP/BHP conversions. Null if absent.

ratedCapacityBHP.description: Rated BHP as a number. Use when permit states 'BHP'/'bhp'. Do not convert from kW. Null if absent.

ratedCapacityHP.description: Rated HP (not BHP) as a number. Do not convert from kW. Null if absent.

ratedCapacityMMBtuPerHr.description: Explicit rated heat-input capacity in MMBtu/hr, numeric value without units. Do not convert from kW or HP; null if absent.

primaryFuelType.description: Primary fuel type verbatim (e.g., 'diesel fuel', 'No. 2 distillate', 'natural gas'). Do not normalize. Put grades in fuelGrade; null if absent.

secondaryFuelType.description: Secondary fuel type for dual-fuel generators exactly as written. Leave null if not applicable.

otherFuels.description: Additional fuels beyond primary and secondary, as free text. Leave null if not applicable.

fuelGrade.description: Fuel grade verbatim. Record all allowed grades. Null if absent.

fuelSpecification.description: Fuel specification standard if cited (e.g., 'ASTM D975', 'ASTM D396'). Copy verbatim. Leave null if not stated.

fuelSulfurContentPct.description: Sulfur content as decimal percentage. Convert ppm to percent (e.g., 15 ppm → 0.0015); percent values already in decimal form (e.g., '0.15%' → 0.0015). Null if absent.

fuelCertificationRequired.description: True if fuel supplier certification is explicitly required with each shipment. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

fuelChangePermitTrigger.description: Permit language on when fuel changes require permit modification. Null if absent.

fuelThroughputPerUnitLimit.description: Max fuel consumption per unit as a number. When BOTH per-unit and combined limits exist, use this for per-unit; use fuelThroughputCombinedLimit for aggregate. Null if absent.

fuelThroughputPerUnitScope.description: Scope of the per-unit fuel throughput limit: 'per_unit' per generator, 'combined_group' for a named group, 'facility_wide' for all generators. Null if absent.

fuelThroughputPerUnitGroupRef.description: Generator group reference when per-unit throughput applies to a group (e.g., 'EG01-EG07', 'FGEMGENS'). Verbatim. Null if not applicable.

fuelThroughputCombinedLimit.description: Aggregate fuel throughput cap when BOTH per-unit and combined limits exist. Null if only per-unit limit or not specified.

fuelThroughputCombinedGroupRef.description: Generator group reference for the combined fuel throughput limit. Verbatim. Null if fuelThroughputCombinedLimit not used.

controlTechnology.description: Emission control technology or devices as written in permit (e.g., 'turbocharged engine and aftercooler', 'SCR', 'DOC'). Leave null if not specified.

operatingHoursPerUnitLimit.description: Max operating hours per unit as a number. When BOTH per-unit and combined limits exist, use this for per-unit; use operatingHoursCombinedLimit for aggregate. Null if absent.

operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow.description: Rolling window for the per-unit operating hours limit, verbatim (e.g., 'consecutive 12-month period', 'running 12 month total'). Null if absent.

operatingHoursCombinedLimit.description: Aggregate operating hours cap when BOTH per-unit and combined limits exist (e.g., total runtime for all generators). Null if only per-unit limit or not specified.

operatingHoursCombinedGroupRef.description: Generator group reference for the combined operating hours limit. Verbatim. Null if operatingHoursCombinedLimit not used.

operatingHoursCombinedRollingWindow.description: Rolling window for combined hours limit if different from the per-unit window. Verbatim. Null if not specified.

allowedOperatingModes.description: Allowed operating modes verbatim (e.g., 'emergency only', 'emergency, maintenance and testing', NSPS/MACT operational definitions). Null if not specified.

opacityLimitPercent.description: Opacity limit as percent if explicitly stated (e.g., 20 for 20%). Leave null if not stated.

hourMeterRequired.description: True if hour meter is explicitly required. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

observationFrequency.description: Monitoring/observation frequency exactly as written (e.g., 'daily when operated', 'monthly', 'quarterly'). Leave null if not specified.

recordkeepingWindowYears.description: Number of years to retain records if explicitly stated (e.g., 5). Leave null if not specified.

nspsSubpartIIII.description: True if NSPS Subpart IIII is explicitly stated as applicable. False if explicitly stated as not applicable. Null if not mentioned.

mactSubpartZZZZ.description: True if MACT Subpart ZZZZ is explicitly stated as applicable. False if explicitly stated as not applicable. Null if not mentioned.

extractionNotes.description: Optional notes documenting extraction decisions (e.g., multiple make/model options, capacity ambiguities). Leave null if straightforward.
